text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeek, oh nooo~!
Fuku-chan-senpai, you spilled the milk!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyoeeeeh, it's drifting this way!?
Save us from flood and misfortune, Namu Amida Butsu, begone~~~!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur in the Hallway
text_block_list.text: Shut up!

text_block_list.name: The Two Machikanes
text_block_list.text: !? Excuse me—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, we got scolded yet again,
O-Machi-san...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees... Our room gets so noisy
that people have started calling it
the Haunted Surprise Room, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh, we can't let this go on!
If it's come to this, to exorcise these bad rumors...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go out tomorrow and make a huge racket!
Once we let it all out, they won't even have the energy left to cause trouble!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! All right,
I'm gonna fool around with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "First up is karaoke! Super! Sound! Health! Super! Sound! Health!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh-oooh-oh! Oh-oooh-oh!
Matikaneee Sisterssss~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Next is dance!
Honjaga, honja, bupposo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Pa-pa-ra, pa-pa-ra, hoi-hoi-pee♪
Ba-ba-baaaam!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Umamusume Confessions! I'm gonna shout my true feelings from the rooftop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The accuracy rate of my fortunes is—!
Fifty-fifty—!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: They always say I'm indecisive, but...! Um, what should I shout? W-Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phewww, we really made quite a ruckus today,
didn't we, Fuku-chan-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, I don't have a single drop of energy left...
Good niiight......

text_block_list.name: The Two Machikanes
text_block_list.text:
GURRROOOOAAAAARRRR!!!!
SHUUUUGOOOOOAAAAARRRR!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur in the Hallway
text_block_list.text: Shut uuup!!!!!!!!!

Snoring and angry shouts loud enough to pierce
right through the dorm roof could be heard.
